description: Create ONE chart. type_code: line, bar, column, pie, doughnut, area, scatter. The X axis comes from a field of the table (property_id): axis_l mth puts each record's value of that field along it (a date, a number, a name — not «by month»), axis_l field one bar per choice of a dropdown, radio or checkbox field. data_sources are the series. Several charts for a dashboard: create_dashboard_charts.

axis_l.description: mth = the values of the property_id field; field = the choices of the property_id field

property_id.description: The number field for the Y axis

entity_id.description: The table of the X axis

property_id.description: The field along the X axis (id or name)

type_code.description: line, bar, column, pie, doughnut, area, scatter

name: create_chart
